tools.name: chronicleonline_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (and contractors, visitors, agency staff) with their badge ids, names and cost centre. Good first call to find an employee id. Chronicle API: GET /api/Employees.

tools.name: chronicleonline_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id. Chronicle API: GET /api/Employees/{id}.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_absences
tools.description: List absences configured in Chronicle (for example holiday, sickness and other absence entries). Chronicle API: GET /api/Absences.

tools.name: chronicleonline_get_absence
tools.description: Get one absence by id. Chronicle API: GET /api/Absences/{id}.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_absence_types
tools.description: List the absence types (holiday, sickness, absence and others) that Chronicle uses. Chronicle API: GET /api/AbsenceTypes.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_absentee_records
tools.description: List absentee records: the per-employee records of absence taken. Chronicle API: GET /api/AbsenteeRecords.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_real_clockings
tools.description: List real clockings: the IN and OUT punches recorded at the terminals and apps. Chronicle API: GET /api/RealClockings.

tools.name: chronicleonline_get_real_clocking
tools.description: Get one real clocking by id. Chronicle API: GET /api/RealClockings/{id}.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_shifts
tools.description: List shift patterns defined in Chronicle. Chronicle API: GET /api/Shifts.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_scheduled_shifts
tools.description: List shifts scheduled to employees between two dates (both required). Chronicle API: GET /api/ScheduledShifts?startDate&endDate.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_work_records
tools.description: List work records (worked time per employee) between two dates. Optional employee filter. Chronicle API: GET /api/WorkRecords.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_daily_overtime
tools.description: List daily overtime per employee between two dates. Chronicle API: GET /api/DailyOvertime.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_weekly_overtime
tools.description: List weekly overtime per employee between two dates. Chronicle API: GET /api/WeeklyOvertime.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_cost_centres
tools.description: List cost centres used to group employees and time. Chronicle API: GET /api/CostCentres.

tools.name: chronicleonline_list_leavers
tools.description: List employees who have left (leavers). Chronicle API: GET /api/Leavers.
